entity_type_reserved: This entity type is managed by its business module. Use the corresponding business page.
entity_has_files: The entity cannot be deleted while its file root contains retained files or folders. Remove or transfer them first.
role_name_conflict: A role with this name already exists in the tenant. Choose a different role name.
permission_not_found: The requested IAM permission does not exist. Choose a permission from the current catalog.
invalid_request: The IAM request is invalid. Check its identifiers, names, permissions, status, and version.
resource_not_found: The requested IAM resource was not found in this tenant. Verify the identifier and tenant, then try again.
resource_conflict: The IAM resource conflicts with existing data or its current version. Reload the resource and retry with the latest version.
tenant_member_inactive: The principal is not an active member of this tenant. Activate the membership before assigning access.
membership_already_exists: The principal is already a member of this organization. Manage the existing membership instead.
directory_assignee_not_found: The requested group assignee was not found. Refresh the directory and choose an existing assignee.
directory_assignee_inactive: The requested group assignee is inactive. Activate it or choose another assignee.
last_tenant_administrator: The last active tenant administrator cannot be removed or disabled. Assign another active administrator first.
entity_not_found: The requested entity was not found in this tenant. Verify the entity identifier and tenant, then try again.
entity_conflict: The entity conflicts with existing data or its current version. Reload it and retry with the latest version or a unique value.
entity_has_children: The entity cannot be deleted while it has child entities. Move or delete the child entities first.
entity_has_role_bindings: The entity cannot be deleted while role bindings reference it. Remove the role bindings first.
entity_hierarchy_conflict: The entity hierarchy change would create an invalid parent relationship. Choose a parent in the same tenant outside this subtree.
authorization_policy_changed: The authorization policy changed during evaluation. Retry the request.
invalid_role_data_scope: The role data scope is invalid. Choose a supported scope and valid department identifiers.
role_data_scope_department_required: The selected-departments scope requires at least one department.
role_data_scope_departments_not_allowed: Department identifiers are only allowed for the selected-departments scope.
role_scope_department_not_found: A selected role-scope department was not found in this tenant. Refresh the department list and choose existing departments.
role_scope_department_inactive: A selected role-scope department is inactive. Enable it or choose another department.
member_department_not_found: The member's primary department was not found in this tenant. Refresh the department list and choose an existing department.
member_department_inactive: The member's primary department is inactive. Enable it or choose another department.
entity_has_relationships: The entity cannot be deleted while relationship grants reference it. Remove those relationships first.
invalid_relationship: The relationship tuple is invalid. Use a supported subject and relation; for an entity match its type, and for a business resource provide its active owning entity and a declared resource type.
relationship_subject_not_found: The relationship subject was not found in this tenant. Refresh the directory and choose an existing principal, group, or entity.
relationship_subject_inactive: The relationship subject is inactive in this tenant. Activate it or choose another subject before granting access.
relationship_resource_inactive: The relationship resource is inactive. Activate the entity or choose another active resource before granting access.
relationship_hierarchy_conflict: The relationship would create a cycle or exceed the supported graph depth. Remove the conflicting path or choose a shallower relationship.
invalid_resource_authorization: The business-resource authorization request is invalid. Provide both resource type and resource ID, and choose a data-scoped permission whose resource matches that type.
invalid_relationship_window: The relationship validity window is invalid. Use RFC 3339 timestamps, set the end after the optional start, and choose an end time in the future.
invalid_relationship_condition: The relationship condition is invalid. Use a version 1 condition with supported trusted-context fields and operators, within the documented size and depth limits.
role_permission_not_granted: This permission is not granted to the role. Grant the permission before configuring its condition.
invalid_role_permission_condition: The role permission condition is invalid. Use a version 1 condition with supported trusted-context fields and operators, within the documented size and depth limits.
platform_administrator_not_found: The principal holds no platform authorization. Grant platform permissions before updating or revoking them.
last_platform_administrator: This change would leave the platform without a full administrator. Promote another principal first.
platform_permission_scope: Only platform-scope permissions can be granted to a platform administrator. Choose a code from the platform permission catalog.
privilege_escalation_denied: You cannot grant a permission you do not hold yourself. Ask a tenant administrator to perform this assignment.
unavailable: The IAM service is unavailable. Retry after the database and its dependencies recover.
activity_event_iam_core_menus_synced_des: Business event: Identity and access · menus: synchronized. Published by Identity and access; subscribed handlers react to this fact.
activity_job_iam_core_menu_contributions: Identity and access: Synchronizes module-declared menus with stored menus and their ownership.
